slices.focus: Ariana discovers place-based memoir and food writing as a restorative alternative to work reading
slices.summary: After a tense period, Ariana visits Janelle, borrows a Gulf Coast foodways essay collection, and realizes she needs non-work reading by her bedside. She plans a small book basket for companionable books and asks Janelle for more recommendations.
open_loops: Creating a small bedside basket for companionable reading
Asking Janelle for a short list of similar essay collections
Maintaining the boundary between work-reading and rest-reading
decisions: Ariana's bedside stack expanded from oral-history collections, local history, and preservation guides to include more pl
